title: Re-Send Allowance After a Settlement Agent's Own-Error Return: Closing and Funding Table
content:
**Standard.** For a Closing and Funding late-funding refund, the re-send allowance, in business days, is set from the closing's wires and closing method:

| Closing's wires and method | Re-send allowance |
|---|---|
| the settlement agent returned a wire through its own error, and the closing method funds only after the signed package is reviewed | the method's package review business days plus its returned-wire re-send business days |
| the settlement agent returned a wire through its own error, and the closing method wires funds at signing | the method's returned-wire re-send business days |
| any other case | no re-send allowance (zero business days) |

A return counts as the settlement agent's own error when it is a wire return marked as a settlement agent rejection and the returned wire's amount equals the amount of the wire that funded the loan (the outgoing wire sent on the disbursement date); a returned wire whose amount differs carried Larkspur's wrong amount, and its days are not taken out of a late-funding refund.

## Resulting allowance by closing method (when the settlement agent returned a wire through its own error)

| Closing method | Funds at signing? | Package review (business days) | Returned-wire re-send (business days) | Re-send allowance |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Larkspur Traditional Wet Closing | Yes | 0 | 1 | 1 |
| Larkspur Escrow Dry-Funding Closing | No | 1 | 1 | 2 |
| Larkspur Mobile Notary Closing | Yes | 0 | 1 | 1 |
| Larkspur Hybrid eClosing | Yes | 0 | 1 | 1 |
| Larkspur Remote Online Notarization Closing | Yes | 0 | 1 | 1 |
| Larkspur Power of Attorney Closing | Yes | 1 | 1 | 1 (the method wires at signing, so its review days are not added) |
| Larkspur Mail-Away Closing | No | 1 | 1 | 2 |

## Cases (hypothetical)

- A Mail-Away closing whose settlement agent sent back, as a rejection, a wire of exactly the funding amount: allowance 2 business days.
- The same closing where the rejected wire's amount differs from the funding wire: the return is not the agent's own error, and there is no re-send allowance.
- A closing with no wire return at all: no re-send allowance.
